short_dxf_validation.method: Fresh all-ten-catalog recognition of the same 84 saved DXFs. All recognition fields match rc31 exactly; all entitydb group tags match except validated writer time, and every original entity is preserved. Not 84 PDF conversions.

remaining_limits: Combined short-catalog corpus remains 69/84 complete; 14 cases have no independent font lock and one has a large internal punctuation conflict.
All 12 historical/additional pages have zero external font locks and no newly recovered outline text; retained geometry is not text-recognition acceptance.
Two of three calibrated additional pages fail the 0.2% dimension gate. Unknown scale and paper output remain explicit.
The 84/84 matching-face PDF result belongs to rc31 and is not rerun or claimed as universal-font accuracy.
